0.0: I heard that explosion all the way up here. I take it you were successful? \r\n#L0##b#p3001007# tells me we took down a supply base. The cannon is a mighty weapon. #l\n#k
0.1: It takes a strong operator to handle the Blue Dragon Cannon. It was your will and concentration that hit the target, not your aim. \r\n#L0##bI could feel the power of the ancient Nova pulsing through my muscles.#l\n#k
0.2: Good. The test fire was a complete success. We can proceed now...\r\n#L0##bTo victory!#l\n#k
0.3: An old man named #b#p3001002##k lives beyond the #b#m401020000##k. He has information we will need to push into the central regions. I want you to go get it. Give him this #rcookie#k while you're at it,  hehehehe...

yes.0: Do not forget to give that old coot the cookie. It's very important.\r\n\n#b(This lady is creeping me out...)#k

no.0: If you aren't going to do it, just eat the cookie and be on your way. Hmph.

1.0: Huh? Who are you? Leave me alone, you look like a big, red idiot.\r\n#L0##bI... brought you this cookie.#l\n#k
1.1: Oh, well, I guess I can give you a moment or two of my time...

yes.0: This looks oddly familiar. Let's have a taste... BLEAACHGGH!! \r\n#bHahaha, what?#k

item.0: Hmph. Get out of here before I crack you one with my walking stick!
